title: Wayfare Pro Refund Relief (Wayfare Pass Window Refunds)
content:
# Wayfare Pro refund relief

*Wayfare Pass (rider membership): period fees refunded under the full refund window.*

**Definition.** The Wayfare Pro refund relief follows the Wayfare Pro status on the member's own driver earnings account: 5.00 at Wayfare Pro Platinum, Diamond or Diamond Elite, 2.50 at Wayfare Pro Gold or Silver, nothing at Wayfare Pro Blue or without an earnings account.

**Effect.** The relief lowers the amount withheld from the window refund by that sum. What is withheld never goes below 0.00, so the relief never raises the window refund above the period fee.

**Source of the status.** The member's own earnings account in Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro, on the same customer profile, and the Wayfare Pro status it carries for the quarter.

| Wayfare Pro status | Relief (USD) |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 2.50 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 2.50 |
| Wayfare Pro Blue | nothing |
| no earnings account | nothing |

**Examples (hypothetical).** With 9.83 withheld and Wayfare Pro Diamond, 4.83 remains withheld. With 1.20 withheld and Wayfare Pro Gold, nothing remains withheld, not a negative amount.
